Market today: The chip sector is under pressure, driven by Nvidia's 7% drop and rumors of CEO Jensen Huang's removal. This creates significant headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip book. Treasury yields also edged higher, adding to caution for growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -70.62% on a 3X leveraged ETF. MUU is also deeply in the red at -49.58%, and SMCI is down -30.65%. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further developments regarding Nvidia's leadership and any broader impact on the semiconductor industry. Also, monitor Treasury yields for continued upward pressure.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply losing, leveraged chip positions.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL stop: Your SOXL stop at 200 is far from the current 66.03. Consider a tighter, functional stop to manage the -70.62% loss on this 3X leveraged ETF.
Trim CRWD: Take some profit on CRWD (+30.94%) to reduce overall portfolio risk, especially with margin, given the current market uncertainty.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The chip sector news is too uncertain for new long positions, despite some scanner setups.
